description.p: PZ Admin brings player management, server settings, and console commands together in a graphical interface for Project Zomboid server administrators.

ul.li: Edit server options and run console commands.
Manage players, assign roles, grant XP, and take moderation actions.
Give items to players and spawn vehicles using searchable catalogs.
Compose messages with a rich text editor that supports Project Zomboid formatting.
Control the weather and save the world.
Save connection profiles for your servers.
